wave: SEMANTIC PRESERVATION -- glob-shaped workspace members (`members = ["crates/*"]`) were never expanded, silently dropping dependency-role evidence for the large majority of consumers in exactly this shape of workspace
wave_title: The same second delegated fresh-census investigation that found the backend_roots omission (fixed in the immediately preceding generation) also flagged, as its highest-confidence finding, that `workspace_members` treats a Cargo directory-glob member entry (`"crates/*"`) as a literal string, never expanding it to the real subdirectories underneath. Verified independently against this repository's own committed donor corpus before acting.
priority_classification: semantic preservation (priority 3) -- real, already-computed dependency evidence (a manifest's own declared role for a workspace-member crate) was silently discarded for a very common real-world Cargo idiom, not a rare edge case.
gap_discovered_by: Delegated Explore-agent investigation. Confirmed the shape is real and common by grepping the donor corpus: `.atlas/temporary/donors/{ast-grep,mold,object,rust-analyzer}/Cargo.toml` all declare a workspace member this way (e.g. `object`'s `members = ["crates/*"]`, `mold`'s `members = ["cli", "arch/*", "tests"]`).
verification_before_acting: Independently confirmed the real donor shape myself: `.atlas/temporary/donors/object/Cargo.toml` line 127 is `members = ["crates/*"]`, and `.atlas/temporary/donors/object/crates/` really contains subdirectories (`examples`, `rewrite`, and others) with their own `Cargo.toml` files.

Wrote a throwaway probe test (deleted after confirming) that ran `census_cargo_workspace` against the real `object` donor and printed its own edge/role counts BEFORE implementing any fix: 61 total edges, only 7 with an evidenced role -- confirming the vast majority of this donor's real consumers had zero role coverage, exactly the predicted consequence of the glob never expanding.

Grepped the whole donor corpus for every member-array glob pattern actually used (`crates/*`, `arch/*`, `lib/*`) to confirm the scope of the fix (a single trailing `/*` component) matches real evidence -- ruled out supporting a bare `"*"` or multi-`*` nested patterns, since no real donor manifest uses either shape.

Falsified the fix directly: temporarily removed the one `expand_glob_members` call site, re-ran the new end-to-end regression test, confirmed it failed with the exact expected `role: None` mismatch, then restored the fix and re-ran to confirm it passes.

design_decisions.question: Expand glob members inside `workspace_members` itself, or as a separate post-processing step?
design_decisions.decision: Separate `expand_glob_members(root: &Path, members: Vec<String>) -> Vec<String>` function, called once in `census_cargo_workspace` right after `workspace_members` returns. `workspace_members` itself stays a pure, filesystem-free string parser (matching its own existing unit-testability and the file's established separation of parsing from filesystem I/O); glob expansion inherently requires `fs::read_dir`, so it belongs at the orchestration layer, not inside the pure parser.

design_decisions.question: How to decide whether a discovered subdirectory is really a workspace member?
design_decisions.decision: Only a subdirectory containing its own `Cargo.toml` is treated as an expanded member -- matching Cargo's own real behavior (a glob member with no manifest would be a Cargo error, not a silently-included non-crate directory) and consistent with this parser's own graceful-degradation style elsewhere (a nonexistent member manifest is already silently skipped, never fabricated).

design_decisions.question: Support the general Cargo glob grammar (nested `*`, multiple `*` per pattern, bare `"*"`), or only what real donor input demonstrates?
design_decisions.decision: Deliberately narrower: only a single trailing `/*` component, matching every real instance found in this repository's own 57-donor corpus. Documented explicitly in `expand_glob_members`'s own doc comment as a scope boundary to broaden only with real evidence, matching this file's established evidence-before-code discipline (the same discipline that deferred the target-conditional dotted-dependency-table combination in the immediately preceding generation).

stable_validator_law_compliance.claim: A workspace member declared as `"prefix/*"` now expands to every real subdirectory of `prefix` that has its own `Cargo.toml`, each treated exactly like an ordinary literal member (its own declared dependency roles attributed, its own manifest path recorded as evidence). A non-glob member, or a glob prefix with no matching subdirectories, is unaffected or expands to nothing -- never fabricates a member that does not exist on disk.
stable_validator_law_compliance.self_written_evidence: Three new unit tests (`a_glob_member_expands_to_its_real_subdirectories_containing_a_cargo_toml`, `a_glob_member_with_no_matching_directory_expands_to_nothing_not_a_crash`, `a_glob_shaped_workspace_member_attributes_dependency_roles_for_every_real_subcrate`) plus one new real-donor-corpus test (`real_object_donor_glob_members_are_evidenced_not_dropped`, asserting substantial evidenced-role coverage now that `crates/*` expands). The end-to-end synthetic test was confirmed to FAIL with the exact expected `role: None` mismatch before the fix, by temporarily removing the one `expand_glob_members` call site and re-running.
stable_validator_law_compliance.independent_evidence_channel: cargo build --workspace clean. cargo fmt --all --check clean. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, zero warnings. Full cargo test --workspace: 289 adapter (+4 net), 2 apps/cli, 161 core, 72 runtime -- 524 total, 0 failed. A throwaway probe run against the real `object` donor before implementing anything (7 of 61 edges evidenced) contrasted with the same donor's own new permanent regression test after the fix (`evidenced_edges > 10`, comfortably passing). `docs audit`: gate_ready true.

implementation.adapter_change: adapter/src/dependency/cargo.rs -- new `expand_glob_members(root, members)` function, called once in `census_cargo_workspace` immediately after `workspace_members` returns, before the member-manifest-reading loop.

adversarial_and_falsification_coverage: a_glob_member_expands_to_its_real_subdirectories_containing_a_cargo_toml also covers two adjacent false-positive risks in one test: a subdirectory with no Cargo.toml (must not be treated as a member) and a non-directory file sitting under the glob prefix (must not crash the scan)

the end-to-end synthetic test was independently confirmed to fail without the fix (not merely written and left green), the same discipline applied to both fixes in the immediately preceding generation

quantified real-world impact BEFORE implementing (a throwaway probe against the real `object` donor: 7/61 edges evidenced) rather than assuming the fix mattered from code review alone -- this is the second generation in a row where a throwaway empirical probe preceded the fix, not just the test

cargo test --workspace.totals: 289 adapter (+4 net), 2 apps/cli, 161 core, 72 runtime -- 524 total, 0 failed

recensus_scope_after_promotion: no prior CLOSED/EXTINCT conclusion is affected
this repository's own workspace is unaffected -- Atlas's own `.atlas/repo.toml`/root Cargo.toml uses only literal, non-glob members

the general lesson from this and the two immediately preceding generations (real donor Cargo.toml files repeatedly exercise a Cargo manifest shape this hand-rolled parser's own narrow, evidence-scoped design had not yet covered: mixed root+workspace manifests, dotted single-dependency tables, and now glob-shaped members) suggests a future generation could do one more targeted sweep of the donor corpus for any remaining unhandled manifest shape before moving to a different area entirely -- flagged as a candidate, not undertaken this generation
the general Cargo glob grammar (nested `*`, multiple `*` per pattern, bare `"*"`) remains an explicit, evidence-gated TARGET, not silently unhandled
overall_verdict: MATERIALIZED AND VERIFIED. Glob-shaped workspace members (`"crates/*"`), a real and common Cargo idiom used by multiple donors in this repository's own corpus, are now expanded to their real subdirectories before dependency-role attribution runs. Quantified real-world impact before and after (`object` donor: 7/61 evidenced edges before, comfortably >10 after) and confirmed the fix's own regression test genuinely fails without it. Full workspace suite (524 tests) passing, gate_ready true.
